title: Publish authorized task commits with exact retry and recoverable push
outcome: Publish authorized task commits with exact retry and recoverable push
acceptance: An immutable private publication intent retains exact resolved bytes, cut/profile/bases, configured target/ref, commit tree/parents/author/time and attribution before effects; only the ordinary approved source landing path or Greg's word authorizes commit/push, with explicit setup-path selection for the initial approved changeset and no implicit authority from opt-in, command flags or journal state.

Product-created task-only commits use an isolated commit tree plus short real-index lock, branch compare-and-swap and witnessed selected-entry before/after reconciliation preserving unrelated entries/flags/conflicts/worktree bytes; an authorized external merge commit can instead be adopted by exact tree/parents/operation without a second bookkeeping commit.

Retries reuse the same operation/candidate/recipe/commit across process exits before and after object/ref/index/progress steps; unchanged task output, renewals and import echoes create no empty data commit. Competing branch/index/worktree changes refuse with all retained material intact.

S0-backed non-force push targets the exact retained commit and configured ref; non-fast-forward retains its intent for a separately admitted successor, unknown push is confirmed only by exact configured-branch tip/verified ancestry, and owned local fixtures exercise credential failure, timeout, rejected/ambiguous push and restart without claiming real-remote proof.

Independent private Git-admin journal/local retention refs remain separate from B1/B2 and canonical SQLite import progress; no force-push, rebase, shared data branch, TermAl relay, SQLite/schema/projection mutation or authority-policy exemption is introduced.
disposal_reason: Superseded: its acceptance excludes a shared data branch, which contradicts the current design. Data-branch fast-forward pushes are authorized by the AGENTS rule landed in 22bfe632 under rules-greg-engram-termal-data-exchange-2026-11-15. The exact-retry fast-forward publish belongs to the one-command item w-6ea6f92ccffc. Closed under rules-greg-close-senseless-tasks-2026-11-08; nothing is claimed as implemented.
